description: Create standard fillable AcroForm fields in an existing PDF at exact positions: text, multiline text, checkbox, radio group, dropdown and signature box. Coordinates are PDF points measured from the bottom-left corner of the page as the viewer sees it (1 inch = 72 pt; US Letter is 612 x 792), the same frame and 1-based page numbers as pdf_edit; x and y are the field's bottom-left corner and the whole rectangle must lie inside the page (each side at least 4 pt). Every entry needs type, name and page; every type except radio also needs x, y, width and height; radio and dropdown need options. Unknown keys are rejected. A radio entry is one group whose options each carry their own value, x, y, width and height. name is 1-200 characters with no dot, unique in the request and not already a field name in the PDF (a name that equals the first part of an existing dotted name is also taken). Text takes multiline, max_length, default and font_size; checkbox takes checked; dropdown takes options (strings), default and font_size. All entries also take required, read_only, border (default true) and background (default false). font_size is a number from 1 to 200 or "auto". If omitted, text, multiline text and dropdown fields get a fixed size of min(12 pt, the largest size at which one line fits the field height), at least 4 pt, so they draw predictably when filled; a value longer than the box is then clipped, not shrunk. "auto" stores size 0, and pdf_fill then sizes the text to the box when the blank field is first filled (a short value is enlarged, a long one shrunk) and keeps that size, so a later, longer value is clipped: for predictable text omit font_size or set a number. Defaults and dropdown options use standard fonts (WinAnsi characters only: euro sign and curly quotes work, Polish L-stroke and CJK fail). The signature type creates an EMPTY signature field for a signing tool to use: nothing is signed, it is not an e-signature. At most 200 entries and 200 widgets per call, and 2,000 fields in the finished form. Fields are plain AcroForm with no JavaScript. Fill the result with pdf_fill (pdf_inspect lists the new fields). Returns the PDF inline as an application/pdf resource; the source is never modified.

fields.description: Fields to create. Nothing is added unless every entry is valid. Required keys: every entry type, name, page; text, checkbox, dropdown and signature also x, y, width, height; radio and dropdown also options (radio options carry their own rectangles).

background.description: Paint an opaque white background. Default false (none).

border.description: Draw a black 1 pt outline. Default true.

checked.description: Checkbox only: start ticked. Default false.

default.description: Text, radio (one option value) or dropdown (one option): the starting value.

font_size.description: Text and dropdown: points (1-200), or "auto" (size chosen at the first fill, then kept). Omitted: a fixed min(12, largest size that fits one line in the height), at least 4.

height.description: Height in points. Not used by radio.

multiline.description: Text only: allow several lines. Default false.

name.description: Field name: no dot, unique, not already in the PDF.

options.description: Dropdown: strings. Radio: objects with value, x, y, width and height.

value.description: Option value, unique in the group, not "Off".

read_only.description: Set the field's ReadOnly flag. Default false.

required.description: Set the field's Required flag. Default false.

width.description: Width in points. Not used by radio.

x.description: Left edge in points from the page's left. Not used by radio.

y.description: Bottom edge in points from the page's bottom. Not used by radio.

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

name: pdf_add_fields

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

warning.description: Present as xfa-layer-dropped when a hybrid AcroForm/XFA input lost its XFA layer

title: Add fillable form fields to a PDF
